'''Gal Kalling''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the Executive Chief of Security at the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Kalling greeted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] visited Kuat Orbital and informed Vader of an ongoing investigation that Kalling was conducting on the whereabouts of [[Birra Seah]], another employee of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Darth Vader dismissed the report, informing Kalling that Seah was of no interest to him.<ref name="SW13" />
